mission.title: Recruit with Machines
mission.description: Meet a Machine team and extract a potential redpill.

phase.briefing: The Machines claim they are innocent of breaking the Truce. They say they can prove it by helping us stop these so called imposters. We need you to hook up with one of their teams and protect a potential redpill contact. I don't know about you, but I think this is strange. Machines actually helping us recruit... A few Machine Operatives are guarding our man, Dallas Vandenberg, at this location. Just meet up with the Programs and Dallas Vandenberg, and then lead Dallas Vandenberg to the REP and extract him from the Matrix.

enter.say: The code that I'm seeing pass by isn't what I was expecting... The Machine Operatives may have upgraded or changed somehow. I don't know for sure if these are Machine Operatives or not, as the signatures that I'm seeing are those of programs.

objective.text: Meet up with the Machine Operatives

done.say: What the...?! Have the Machines betrayed us?! Show them that Zion will not go quietly!

objective.text: Kill all of the imposter programs
Get the communique from the Machine Operative

done.say: Oh no... That must be Dallas Vandenberg! Those bastards killed him! Get out of there before more show up and they kill you as well!

mission.finish: Maybe we'll have better luck next time, {player}.
